title: Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 – A Commentary
author: Somesh Arora & Salil Arora
subject: Law
description:
Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 – A Commentary (Second Edition)
•	Revised and fully updated section-wise commentary covering all the landmark judicial decisions
•	The seminal decision in Vijay Madanlal Choudhary has been discussed in detail and analysed meticulously. 
•	Exhaustively deals with all the key aspects of the PMLA, 2002.
•	Includes the Act, Rules, and important Notifications.
•	Updated developments at the international level in Financial Action Task Force.
•	Insight into the offence of money-laundering and its ever-evolving legal and regulatory framework. 
•	Thoroughly deals with all the definitions of Scheduled Offences drawn from various legislations.
•	Crucial learnings and techniques to benefit investigators and defence counsels in meeting their mandates in a PMLA case.
•	Useful for practitioners, judges, enforcement agencies, investigators, academics and students

title: Constitutional Ideals – Development and Realisation Through Court-led Justice
author: Daksh ( Editor - Shruti Vidyasagar, Sandhya P. R., Anindita Pattanayak and Harish Narasappa)
subject: Law
description:
•	Curated volume of essays that describe how the judiciary has interpreted and enriched the Constitution in diverse political, social, and economic circumstances.
•	Various aspects of the Constitution, from how decisions have shaped the identity of citizens, to the changing nature and scope of constitutional rights themselves.
•	Divided into four different segments: 
-	first explores the manner in which individuals engage with the Constitution to demand citizen-centric justice; 
-	second examines the navigation of group identities (such as religion and caste) in constitutional litigation; 
-	third focuses on the significance of procedural rigour in ensuring substantive justice, including in the context of insolvency, preventive detention, and public consultations before executive decisions; and
-	final theme captures constitutional values in flux.

title: Royalty and FTS – Understanding Business and Tax Interplay
author: Sanjay Kumar, SP Singh, and Sharad Goyal
subject: Tax

It seeks to put Business & Tax in the same bracket vis-à-vis the important subject of Royalty & FTS.
• It also delves into the process and mechanism of how the valuation should be accurately done. The book has attempted to bring out the business, economics, and tax perspective on all these topics.
• In-depth analysis of 92 royalty agreements between unrelated parties and their impact on businesses
• Exhaustive coverage of natural resource royalty.

title: Contract Drafting – Tips and Tricks
author: Bhumesh Verma
subject: Law
description:
This book provides practical tips and insights for drafting legally binding contracts that protect the interests of all parties involved.
• The author illustrates common contract drafting issues and provides practical solutions for addressing them.
• With a focus on clear, concise language and a reader-friendly format, this book is an essential resource for anyone involved in contract drafting.
• The book aims to share tips for lawyers, legal professionals, and students who often ask for a perfect contract or how to become a contract drafting expert.

title: Fairytales – A Poetry Anthology
author: Aanya Chand
subject: BGR
description:
•	The book paints a portrait of love—an emotion felt by all but understood by none.
•	From the all-consuming flames of a young love to the cold emptiness of heartbreak.
•	It captures the imagination of every hopeless romantic who dreams of finding a fairytale romance.

title: FAQ’s on the POSH Act
author: Dr. Bharat Nain
subject: Law
description: The topic of sexual harassment at the workplace has received great attention over the last few years, and rightly so. It is a scourge that must be eradicated. The book explains the POSH Act in a Q&A format covering all aspects of sexual harassment at the workplace, including its prevention. It is written in simple language and will benefit HR professionals, leaders & employees. The book also contains easy to interpret infographics, and templates relevant to the POSH Act, along with a draft “Prevention of Sexual Harassment Policy” that can be adapted by any organisation.

title: An Analysis of GST Advance Rulings – Important Propositions
author: Krupa Venkatesh
subject: Tax
description:
•	As with all new legislations, there are ambiguous provisions and new concepts subject to interpretations. 
•	Advance Rulings are powerful tools for planning and tax risk mitigation.
•	This publication covers important Advance Rulings and Appellate Advance Rulings, with suitable notations, wherever required under GST from 2017 to January 2023. 
•	It is meant to be a reference book for tax professionals since it groups advance rulings based on propositions and makes an easy read.

title: India 2047 – High Income With Equity
author: Sameer Kochhar
subject: BGR
description:
Pre-COVID, India had set a target to become a $10 trillion economy by 2030 the action plan for which was outlined in my earlier volume, “India 2030”, released in December 2018. This emphasised the need for quality growth that is job-generative, spatially dispersed, and equitable. 
“India 2047” deals with macroeconomic essentials and emphasises the need for structural transformation, organising the labour markets, increasing competitiveness, enhancing financial and social inclusion with equitable growth, the role of federalism in inclusive growth, imperatives for job-generation, and the importance of infrastructure development and financing.
Despite the COVID-19 pandemic, India has remained afloat, and Prime Minister Narendra Modi has put India in top-gear, setting an ambitious target for the country to become a developed nation by 2047. The next 25 years are going to be critical, and he calls it Amrit Kal, during which India will be focusing on reducing import dependence, reducing compliance costs for small businesses, harnessing digital infrastructure and modern technologies, promoting domestic manufacturing, and taking global leadership—the G20 being one example. This volume aims to review progress and make recommendations to bridge gaps in line with the new target date and objectives. It also discusses the macroeconomic essentials required to make India a high-income country with equity.

title: Mediation Simplified – An Interactive Workbook
author: Nisshant Laroia and Jonathan Rodrigues
subject: Law
description:
•	Mediation Simplified is India’s first interactive workbook on negotiation and mediation, which aims to support the academia who are being tasked to either research or teach the subject at universities across the country.
•	A genuine attempt to illustrate the theory of mediation in a practical and relatable manner. 
•	The intricately curated chapters allow the reader an immersive experience to reflect on conflicting simulations and apply practical tools to strategically de-escalate, objectively analyse, and amicably resolve the conflicting situation.
•	Practitioners of mediation, whether lawyers or mediators, who are not oriented with the subject will also find the book to be a handy tool for research and quick learning.

title: Public Administration and Public Policy Vol I
author: Lohit Matani, IPS
subject: Academic
description:
Public Administration and Public Policy (Volume I) is specially aimed at the aspirants of the Civil Services (Main) Examination. It will also be useful for the aspirants of various state services examinations.
This book is strictly aligned with the syllabus of Public Administration prescribed by UPSC. Going along the line of the syllabus, the book deals with the various aspects of administrative and organisational management and incorporates the thoughts and philosophies of various administrative scholars. Based on the evolution and scope of public administration, the book delves deep into the various paradigms and facets of public administration. In line with the UPSC syllabus, the text includes topics such as administrative thinkers, administrative laws, development administration, accountability and control, and financial management. To facilitate quick assessment, each chapter is followed by a detailed compilation of relevant questions from previous years, as well as practice questions and exercises.
The book includes flowcharts, diagrams, and mind maps to facilitate understanding and retention of concepts. Written in extremely clear and simple language, the book serves as a comprehensive textbook for Paper 1 in Public Administration.
Key Features
•	Provides chapter-by-chapter practise questions for self-assessment.
•	Guide with answers to questions asked over the last 34 years.
•	Contains a trend analysis of assignments over the last few years (2012 to 2022)

title: NCERT-India and World Geography
author: Dr Zubairul Islam
subject: Academic
description:
The NCERT India and World Geography series from OakBridge Publishing comprehensively. covers NCERT Old+ NEW (Class 6-12) and serves as a valuable resource for students preparing for civil services examinations in particular and other examinations in general. It provides selective, systematic, and organised insights into the geographical dimensions of India and the world.
The book consists of three parts - the first dealing with the physical and human aspects of Indian geography; the second with a deeper understanding of the origins of the earth, its geological structure and the dynamic forces that shape its surface; the third dealing with the composition of the human population, examining factors such as age, gender, ethnicity, and migration.
We hope that this book will serve as a springboard to a broader perspective of geography and inspire readers to prepare for various examinations.

title: Rising Relevance of Quality Control and Bureau of Indian Standards
author: Himanshu Tewari
subject: Law
description:
An easy-to-read and understandable collection that touches on essential parts of BIS quality control regulation in India and its interplay with the way of doing business in India.
It provides a roadmap for companies looking to engage with India’s high quality
licensing framework.
The book connects the dots of practical advice to create an easy-to-follow picture while encouraging action and flow in the midst of analysis.

title: Practical Guide to Drafting Commercial Contracts 3/e
author: Bhumesh Verma
subject: Law
description: Practical Guide to Drafting Commercial Contracts is a concise handbook enumerating the key aspects pertaining to drafting effective commercial agreements. Written in a lucid language, the author explains the factors that a draftsman must consider while drafting an agreement that clearly reflects the intent of the parties. A carefully drafted contract must be precise, comprehensive, devoid of contradictions, grammatically accurate and amenable to clear legal interpretation in case of disputes arising therefrom. Contract drafting is a crucial skill that every lawyer must acquire and hone. With the intent to expand the scope of discussion on the various facets of contract negotiation and drafting, especially in this technology driven era, the second edition includes new chapters on e-contracts, damages, intellectual property rights and negotiation. The book also provides specimen drafts of contracts for key commercial transactions for ease of reference by readers. The book will be useful for lawyers, law students and non-lawyers.Bhumesh Verma is the Managing Partner of Corp Comm Legal, an independent Indian law firm headquartered in New Delhi. Besides, he is the convenor of Global Business Lawyers’ League and The Indian Lawyers’ League. With over 25 years’ experience, he is one of the leading Indian senior corporate practitioners ranked inter alia in the ‘A List’ of the Top 100 Indian Lawyers by India Business Law Journal from time to time, most Admired Indian Lawyers, most followed Indian lawyers on LinkedIn, etc. An avid reader, a sought-after speaker, guest faculty and prolific writer, he has contributed to in-house journals of many international law firms on Indian laws and published more than 400 articles so far.

title: Science and Technology – From Inception to Advancement
author: Neeraj Nachiketa
subject: Academic
description: Science and Technology - from Inception to Advancement, Third Edition is an authoritative and most updated book written for the aspirants of Civil Services Preliminary and Main Examinations. This book will also be useful for various state services examinations. Starting with the fundamentals of science and technology infrastructure in India, the book delves deep into the concepts and applications of technologies related to various areas like nuclear, space and defence among others. It provides a detailed insights on the new age technologies like Recombinant DNA Technology, Nanotechnology, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Blockchain, Cryptocurrencies, Internet of Things, Hyperloop, Electric Vehicles, Driverless cars, Robotics etc. While dealing with the scientific aspects of Covid-19, the book discusses the evolution of medical infrastructure during the time of pandemic. Dedicated chapters on agricultural technologies (hydroponics, aquaponics, bio-farming) and earth sciences have been provided for illustrating the change that technology can bring in a sector that employs majority of the Indian population. Diagrams and flowcharts have been used for better understanding.

title: ESM English Studies Manual
author: Ap Bhardwaj
subject: Academic
description:
ESM (English Studies Manual) traces the increasing role and importance of the English language with changed patterns of CLAT & AILET.

ESM is meticulously designed study material to enable the students to face new challenges. It is a clear, compact, and comprehensive book to enable students to prepare for the English section of Law Entrance Exams quickly and confidently.


•	6-in-1 Book
•	6 Parts, 25 Chapters, 300 PTs, 3000 MCQs
•	Complete Coverage of Vocabulary, English Usage, Grammar, Figures of speech, Comprehension, and Solved English section of CLAT/AILET (2021-2023)

title: At the Intersection of Law & Life Essays in Honour of Justice MN Venkatachaliah
author: Bibek Debroy and Sameer Kochhar
subject: Law
description:
A rich collection of essays by eminent personalities on Justice MN Venkatachaliah, the Judge, and the individual. Justice Manepali Narayanarao Venkatachaliah's diverse roles as a Judge in various courts, Chief Justice of India, Chairman of the National Human Rights Commission, Chairman of the Commission to Review the Working of the Constitution, and other positions are covered in the book.

Right from his days at the highest judiciary to his simple superannuated yet emeritus status, Justice Venkatachaliah has preached reforms for efficiency.

The topics include:

Human rights
Tax law
Public Policy
Alternative Dispute Resolution
Arbitration law, energy-related arbitration, and his pro-arbitration approach.
Other topics, like education and the selection of judges, are briefly touched upon. The contributors reflect on his journey from pre-Independent India to witnessing the nation's transformation.

title: Disaster Management, 2/e
author: P Kumar
subject: Academic
description:
Disaster Management has been written for providing insights on various types of disasters and the ways to manage them. It is useful for the aspirants of Civil Services and various State services Examinations. The book begins with an introduction to the subject of disasters and provides information on the different types of natural and man-made disasters. It also covers in detail the various approaches and aspects of disaster management, mitigation techniques, disaster preparedness, capacity building and the role of various stakeholders in disaster management. It also provides information on the various institutions and organisations involved in disaster management.

The book has 27 chapters, with each chapter covering the different aspects of disasters and their management. Flowcharts, maps, diagrams and tables have been used for better understanding.

Key Features -

Questions from previous years for the main exam
Multidisciplinary approach and linkage with Environment and Geography
Presentation of flowcharts, maps, diagrams, and tables
Covers international cooperation in disaster management.
Comprehensive coverage of natural and Man-made Disasters like Train Accidents and Disaster Response.

title: The Good Divorce It’s Not What You Think A Memoir
author: Sarita Salwan
subject: BGR
description:
If she wasn't beaten up, her partner was not lying or cheating, why does a woman want divorce?

For more than a decade, Sarita Salwan häs stayed loyal to her clients, committed to finding the quickest and most relevant solution whenever they need. For more than a decade, Sarita has also stayed committed to her family, ensuring her daughter has a room of her own, and the best of opportunities. That's Sarita, a 43-year-old divorced woman, who decided to separate from her partner after almost 10 years of being married. So,

'Does she live alone now?'

'Her husband did not pay alimony?'

'Who pays all the bills?'

In this atypical memoir, Sarita Salwan, travel agent-cum-DJ, born and brought up in India and Norway, will tell you not what led to the divorce but how she came of age. From a 23-year-old Bollywood loving Punjabi girl who believed that taking off her red bangles or choora before a year of marriage was a sign of bad luck, to the woman who believes if nothing works out, divorce should be seen as an option.

Although she is not a cold-hearted person, she certainly feels good about doing things her way, and doesn't feel guilty afterwards.

title: Indian Polity & Governance , 2/e
author: Nirbhay Sharma
subject: Academic
description:
Indian Polity and Governance is a significant book written specifically for Civil Services aspirants. This brilliantly researched and exceptionally detailed book will also be critical while preparing for various state services examinations. The content, form and structure of the book has been designed in a manner that it can even help students preparing for optional subjects like Law, Political Science and Public Administration, while being of equal significance and relevance to those preparing for Judiciary, CLAT and other Law Entrance Tests. Starting from the history of evolution of the Indian Constitution, the book delves deep into the salient features of the Constitution, the different organs of the government and their respective role in India’s political system, and the functions of constitutional and non-constitutional bodies among others.

Key Features -

Provides strategy to study and prepare the Indian Polity for UPSC.
Provides tables of important articles, schedules, and amendments in the Indian Constitution.
Features solved papers of UPSC Prelims from the year 2011 to 202 & Indian Polity asked in papers of UPSC Mains examination from the year 2013 to 2023.
Embedded with smart code for online support
Provides 10 online mock-tests for self-assessment.

title: The Law of Goods and Services Tax A Comprehensive Commentary
author: Ramakrishnan Viraraghavan
subject: Tax
description:
A detailed section-wise internet age commentary on the CGST Act, IGST Act and GST (Compensation to States) Act.
First commentary on GST written by a Senior Advocate practising at the Supreme Court distilling his vast experience of nearly four decades of litigation practice.
Designed to give quick answers to busy GST adjudicators and GST practitioners without wading through judgements and circulars.
A focused and penetrative commentary based on judgements of the courts and rulings of advance ruling authorities. The relevant pages and paragraphs of the relevant judgements and circulars are referred only in the footnotes.
Vexed issues of classification are dealt in a separate chapter with goods and services arranged alphabetically under their common names. The commentary guides the reader on issues not yet decided by the Supreme Court or the High Courts.
The book incorporates the amendments made by the Finance Act, 2023, the CGST (Amendment) Act, 2023 and the IGST (Amendment) Act 2023. Taxation of supplies in casinos, racecourses and online gaming has been addressed in a separate chapter. Relevant decisions reported in GSTR up to 31 July 2023 have been added in the book.

title: Reforms in Tax Administration An Indian Experience
author: Pratap Singh, IRS
subject: Tax
description:
The book is the result of five years of extensive research, aiming to analyse India's tax system and its administration. The focus is on evaluating tax reforms, particularly those of the last 30 years, and their effects on tax collection, the Tax-GDP ratio, the tax base, and the overall economy. The study explores the relationship between tax and GDP growth, scrutinises the impact of significant 1991 tax reforms on subsequent tax collection, and compares India's tax-GDP ratio with other nations.

Additionally, it investigates the aftermath of the 2008 global economic crisis on taxes, discusses anti-tax evasion measures, and introduces the Tax Administration Diagnostic Assessment Tool Model (TADAT) for assessing tax administration efficiency. The book offers recommendations for improving tax administration and highlights the delayed effects of the 1991 reforms on tax collection and the impact of the 2008 slowdown. It is a valuable resource for researchers, tax professionals, administrators, and economics students.

title: Reform & Deform A Five-Side Critique of GST
author: Rav Pratap Singh
subject: Tax
description:
Reform and Deform: A Five-Side Critique of GST takes stock of the initial five and a half years of GST since its implementation in July 2017.

This book focuses on five separate but inter-related aspects of GST: concept of supply, claims of input tax credit (‘ITC’), jurisprudence on arrests and attachment, dysfunctional dispute resolution framework and sub-par advance ruling mechanism, and a dedicated chapter containing detailed critique of the GST’s anti-profiteering mechanism.

All five aspects are examined to underline the central argument made in the book, i.e., GST is a reform is increasingly being deformed due to poorly reasoned judicial opinions, sub-par advance rulings and uncertainty produced by reactive and ad hoc executive responses.

Reform and Deform is a trailblazer as it presents a structured analysis of GST by deploying a jargon-free and straightforward vocabulary. It examines several legal developments in detail, places them in proper historical context and views GST not as an end in itself but a milestone in India’s continuing journey towards an improved indirect tax regime.

title: Capital Gains Tax Law and Practice
author: TG Suresh
subject: Tax
description:
Capital Gains Tax – Law and Practice comprehensively covers legal and practical aspects governing the taxation of short-term and long-term capital gains as provided under Chapter IV(E) of the Income-Tax Act, 1961. The sixth edition has been thoroughly revised and updated in view of amendments brought in by the Finance Act,2023.

Key Features -

Written in a simple and lucid language.
Practical scenarios and illustrations discussed for better understanding.
Judicial pronouncements have been examined and mentioned as appropriate.
Incorporates all relevant Notifications, Circulars and Schemes up to 30th June 2023
All relevant circulars and notifications have been reproduced under the appendices.
Detailed analysis of capital gains relating to shares, securities, and Business Restructuring transactions.
Provisions relating to Real estate transactions (including JDA) are covered extensively.
Apex Court decisions/interpretations are appropriately highlighted and considered.
Provisions relating to international transactions and Non-residents are covered comprehensively.
Appropriate suggestions provided on Controversial provisions to reduce/avoid litigation.

title: Technology and Analytics for Law & Justice
author: Nomesh Bhojkumar Bolia and Surya Prakash BS
subject: Law
description: This unique volume from the DAKSH Centre of Excellence for Law and Technology examines the evolution of technology in the law and justice system in India. It delves into the challenges and opportunities presented by technology, current thinking on the subject, and what the future may hold for this rapidly developing field. From tracing the historical journey of law and technology in India to the rise of 'justicemakers,' the impact of cutting-edge forensic technology, the world of smart contracts, and the realm of surveillance, this book offers a comprehensive and thought-provoking look at the ever-changing landscape of law and technology. This book will be of interest to a wide audience, including researchers, policymakers, government agencies, technologists, law firms, legal practitioners, academics, and students looking for a head-start in the world of transforming law and justice systems.

title: The Definitive Guide to UPSC Success: Crafting Your IAS Journey
author: Shabbir A Bashir and Deb Tripathi
subject: Academic
description:
Cracking UPSC, the mother of all exams, requires more than just knowledge; it demands a transformation of mindset, vision for success, and an unwavering commitment to nation-building.

‘The Definitive Guide to UPSC Success Crafting Your IAS Journey,' goes beyond conventional study techniques, delving into the realms of mindset and personality development. It is not merely a study guide; it is a holistic approach to navigating the challenges of one of the most rigorous examinations.

‘The Definitive Guide to UPSC Success Crafting Your IAS Journey' is your companion in this transformative journey. Let the wisdom within the pages guide you toward not just passing an exam, but upgrading yourself to a new version, shaping your future.

title: Treatise on Arbitration Law & Practice – A Critical Commentary on Part I of the Act of 1996 (2 Vol. Set)
author: M Sricharan Rangarajan
subject: Law
description:
A section-wise practical commentary on Part I of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 with relevant case laws.
Traces the History of the Arbitration Act, covers UNCITRAL Model Laws and Law Commission reports.
Provides insights into the current legal framework, addresses challenges in arbitration, suggests amendments to enhance its efficacy in resolving commercial disputes.
A practitioner's perspective, maintaining clarity in legal interpretation and expressing ideas in accessible language.
An invaluable guide for arbitrators, practitioners, and aspiring law students interested and specialising in arbitration law and practice.

title: New Range & Orthodox Concerns in International Taxation
author: Parthasarathi Shome
subject: Tax
description:
New Range & Orthodox Concerns in International Taxation covers emerging issues in the various branches of international taxation, advancing International Tax Research and Analysis Foundation’s (ITRAF’s) tradition of bringing together a new range as well as orthodox concerns and presenting them to the expert.

The new range of issues includes the profound ramifications of a steady and speeding emergence of robots, the emerging new international rules for taxing carbon emissions to buttress a green transition, the conversion of the extortion of resources to a new tax collected at checkpoints in Afghanistan, and the dilemma of providing too little or too much tax incentives to attract international professional experts in Sweden. Traditional concerns such as tax avoidance, transparency, and ethics in tax planning are explored, along with issues related to Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS).

The volume contains a comprehensive foreword and the history of national tax systems in a globalised world. Overall, the collection provides a contemporary overview of international tax issues, making it a valuable resource for specialists in the field.

title: Transforming HARYANA 9 Incredible Years of Haryana Government
author: Dr. Kuldip Chand Agnihotri
subject: BGR
description:
A comprehensive compendium presenting an account of nearly a decade of work by the Manohar Lal Government.
Describes in detail, along with data, the nature of the plans, their objectives, the implementing agency, and the classes of society kept in mind while preparing the outline of the plan.
Valuable insights on the comprehensive governance strategies, innovative policies, and impactful projects that have shaped the state’s landscape.
This collection includes three types of articles:
First, articles by scholars who have been active in political life for a long time expressing their opinion on various schemes of the Haryana government.
Second, articles by officers working or who have worked in various positions in the state’s executive regarding the implementation of these schemes.
Third, articles by scholars working in the academic field explaining the long-term impacts of these schemes.

title: हरियाणा सरकार के 9 अतुलनीय वर्ष एक नए एवं जीवंत हरियाणा का उदय
author: प्रोफेसर कुलदीप चन्द अग्निहोत्री
subject: BGR
description:
मनोहर लाल सरकार के लगभग एक दशक के कामकाज का लेखा-जोखा प्रस्तुत करने वाला एक व्यापक सार-संग्रह।
डेटा के साथ-साथ योजनाओं की प्रकृति, उनके उद्देश्य, कार्यान्वयन एजेंसी और योजना की रूपरेखा तैयार करते समय ध्यान में रखे जाने वाले समाज के वर्गों का भी विस्तार से वर्णन करता है।
व्यापक शासन रणनीतियों, नवीन नीतियों और प्रभावशाली परियोजनाओं पर मूल्यवान अंतर्दृष्टि, जिन्होंने राज्य के परिदृश्य को आकार दिया है।
इस संग्रह में तीन प्रकार के लेख शामिल हैं:
सबसे पहले, लंबे समय से राजनीतिक जीवन में सक्रिय रहे विद्वानों के लेख, जो हरियाणा सरकार की विभिन्न योजनाओं पर अपनी राय व्यक्त करते हैं।
दूसरा, इन योजनाओं के कार्यान्वयन के संबंध में राज्य की कार्यकारिणी में विभिन्न पदों पर कार्यरत या काम कर चुके अधिकारियों के लेख।
तीसरा, शैक्षणिक क्षेत्र में काम करने वाले विद्वानों के लेख जो इन योजनाओं के दीर्घकालिक प्रभावों को समझाते हैं।

title: Double Taxation Treaties - Concepts, Practices & Trends (2 Vol. Set)
author: K R Sekar
subject: Tax
description:
A comprehensive exploration of Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements, encompassing prevailing issues & practices as well as emerging trends.
The book considers the increasing complexities relating to digital economy and its impact on the prevailing principles and concepts under the DTAA, while explaining in detail the existing treaties and the latest judicial decisions relating to it.
The two volume set analyses Anti-Avoidance Regulations and practices under relevant provisions including Thin Cap Regulations, CFC Regulations & GAAR.
Additionally, Multilateral Instruments, Pillar 1 and Pillar 2, pertinent issues within select industries, new tax architecture trends & the relevance of OECD amid challenges posed by developing countries have been dealt with in detail.
The book will be a useful reference for tax professionals, policymakers, judicial officers, enforcement authorities, academicians & tax students.

title: Supreme Court of India: Musings, Anecdotes & Episodes
author: N Vijayaraghavan and Sharath Chandran
subject: Law
description:
The book explains the journey of the highest court in India since its inception 75 years ago.
Offers a compelling account of the origins of the Federal Court and Constituent Assembly Debates.
It weaves together a series of thought-provoking narratives relating to appointment of judges, credibility of the judicial institution, judicial legislation, and public interest litigation.
A well-researched critique on select judgments of the Supreme Court with the intent to present an alternative perspective on the issues under discussion in these cases.
Useful for lawyers, legal academics, scholars, researchers, policy makers and interested citizens.

title: Practical Guide to Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 Law and Compliance
author: Puneet Bhasin
subject: Law
description:
Discusses the importance of data protection laws in India in regulating the collection, processing and storage of personal data, particularly in light of technological advancements and the misuse of data by both domestic and foreign entities.
The book provides an in-depth understanding of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, detailing all its provisions. Additionally, it outlines the scope, exceptions and enforcement mechanisms under the Act, along with steps for compliance and penalties for non-compliance.
The book will be useful for Legal Professionals, CISOs, CIOs, Key Management functions of organisations, Data Protection Officers, Policy Makers and Government Officials, Business Executives and Entrepreneurs, Data Privacy Advocates and Activists, Data Subjects, Compliance Officers and Auditors, Technology and Cybersecurity Professionals and International Stakeholders.

title: Court Jester
author: Raju Z Moray
subject: Law
description: This anthology brings together Prose and Poetry which was featured on the ‘Court Jester’ page of the Lawyers Collective Magazine from 1993 to 2003. The feature was immensely entertaining and popular. Long out of print and difficult to access, there was a consistent demand over the years from its fans to collect all the pieces together and publish them as a book. These pieces can still be enjoyed with much pleasure and profit because no one ever learns from their mistakes. Ludicrous behaviour will never go out of fashion, and bloated egos still require puncturing.

title: Tales of Law & Laughter
author: Raju Z Moray
subject: Law
description: This anthology brings together thirty anecdotal stories selected from the popular ‘Adaalat Antics’ series written for theleaflet.in by the author Raju Z. Moray and specially illustrated for this exclusive print edition by Farzana Cooper. Readers will enjoy a humorous view of the life of a lawyer from law college to the Bar and the Bench. These fictional pen-portraits of lawyers and judges have entertained thousands of online readers and there has been an insistent demand from readers to collect and publish this treasury of comic tales in book form. This anthology fulfills that demand.

title: New-Age Economy Taxation: An Overview of Taxation of Digital Businesses
author: CA Pushpendra Dixit
subject: Tax
description:
Analyses the complexities of taxing digital business transactions, focusing on the introduction of Digital Services Taxes (DST) to ensure fair taxation for foreign corporations operating within different market jurisdictions.
Exploring unilateral tax measures adopted globally, with a spotlight on India, the book covers taxation of digital goods, services, and online advertising. It also examines the OECD's Two-Pillar approach, addressing the allocation of taxing rights and establishing a global minimum corporate tax rate.
Further, the book advocates the inclusion of digital transactions in the tax net to level the playing field for businesses.
The book will be useful for tax professionals, financial consultants, multinational corporations, technology firms, policymakers, legal professionals, academicians & tax students.

title: General Studies Paper I-VI | Mock Test and Previous Year Papers
author: Sudhanshu Mishra & CS Nikunj Gupta
subject: Academic
description:
GENERAL STUDIES PAPER I-VI Mock Test and Previous Year Papers is a comprehensive book specifically aims at the aspirants of the UPPSC (Mains) Examination.

This book serves as a valuable tool to aid your exam preparation, offering a deeper insight into the examination pattern, question trends, and crucial concepts. Carefully designed, it provides a strategic edge with comprehensive solutions to the UPPSC previous years' papers and engaging solved mock papers. Each solution comes with clear explanations, helping you grasp the fundamental concepts better and sharpening your problem-solving abilities.

title: Indian Geography Through Maps, 2/e
author: Somesh Kumar Upadhyay
subject: Academic

Indian Geography Through Maps, Second Edition is a comprehensive book on the subject specifically designed for the aspirants of Civil Services examination. It will also be useful for those appearing in various State Services examinations.
The book will help the aspirants to discover the vibrant tapestry of India's geography through maps. This edition provides latest data points sourced from government reports. To ensures clarity, the maps have been updated and illustrated.
A first-of-its-kind attempt, this book presents information with brevity and simplicity to aid preparation for the Civil Services examination.

author: Sumit Pahwa
subject: Law
description: Corporate Law Referencer presents a 360o view of the Companies Act, 2013 and Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008 with section-wise arrangement of all Circulars, Orders, Rules & Notifications including Procedures, FAQs, Resolutions, Adjudication Orders and Judicial Precedents.

title: India’s Odyssey: From a Developing Country to an Emerging Superpower
author: Pratap Singh
subject: BGR
description:
As India embarks on its journey to becoming a developed economy, its developmental odyssey serves as an inspiration and offers time-tested nuggets for aspiring nations striving for all-round progress. India’s Odyssey: From a Developing Country to an Emerging Superpower dives deep into this transformational journey of India — Bharata from its great ancient civilisation to the dark ages of subjugation, followed by its progression into a developing country towards an emerging superpower. The last three decades have seen remarkable changes in India, evident by its modern economy, excellent infrastructure, and an exceptional scientific innovation ecosystem. Armed with a strong military and its ranking as the fifth-largest economy in the world, India radiates confidence in its progress and growth.

The book covers the political journey of the country and important events since Independence. India is already at the cusp of becoming the third largest economy. The author has attempted to capture the holistic economic development of the country that focuses on building a modern and low carbon economy. Recent geopolitical developments and events shaping India and the world right from G-20, BRICS, SCO, QUAD, Ukraine war to Israel-Hamas conflict and other important developments, have also been examined.

title: Electricity Laws in India – A Comprehensive Analysis with Regulatory Provisions & Case Law
author: Karan Trehan
subject: Law
description:
Electricity Laws in India: A Comprehensive Analysis with Regulatory Provisions & Case
Law provides a thorough review of the legal framework that governs the electricity
sector in India. 
It offers: 
•	a detailed analysis of the historical evolution and regulatory framework, elucidating the key legal principles that influence the sector.
•	a comprehensive overview of the development of the electricity sector, from early challenges to the present regulatory environment. 
•	an analysis of the Electricity Act of 2003 and explores the functions of regulatory commissions at both central and state levels.
•	critical topics such as tariff determination, licensing, transmission, distribution, generation compliance, and dispute resolution.

It is a valuable resource for policymakers, legal practitioners, academics, and students interested in understanding electricity laws in India.

title: Sociology
author: Pooja Prasanna
subject: Academic
description:
Sociology covers the UPSC optional syllabus for the subject in its entirety and is designed to the meet the unique requirements of this examination. It will also be useful for those appearing for the State PSC examination with Sociology as their optional subject. 
Arranged meticulously, the book aids a comprehensive understanding of the subject for beginners and those with a background in the subject. The language used in the book is clear and simple, with complex concepts being explained with the help of real-life examples, case studies, and empirical data. The aspirants will find their preparation journey relatively easy with this book offering structured and progressive learning experience, complemented with discussions on contemporary issues. This specifically offers an edge to the aspirants with the ability to relate sociological theories and concepts, and their application to real-world situations. Each chapter also includes previous years’ UPSC questions for the aspirants to assess their readiness and to prepare for the examination effectively.

scenarios

title: History of Ancient India
author: Mrityunjay Rai
subject: Academic
description:
History of Ancient India presents a comprehensive coverage of the subject for the civil services examination. Arranged meticulously, the chapters explain the different stages of the Indian civilisation lucidly with flowcharts and diagrams to aid understanding. Often considered a static subject, the book helps the aspirants in preparing for the ever-changing examination requirement that necessitates looking at the same historical facts in different perspectives and with diverse inter-relations. 

The book makes the subject accessible and aids retention of extensive historical data and information by contextualising the historical events with the overall socio-political and cultural framework of the time. Covering the entire expanse of Ancient History from the rise of the Mesopotamian civilisations to the fall of the Roman Empire, the chapters examine the nuances of the societies, their political structures, religious beliefs, technological advancements, and social norms. 

Why should you choose this book?

3.	Practice questions under each chapter help assess the examination readiness

author: Dr K K Khandelwal, IAS (R)
subject: Law
description:
A comprehensive analysis delving into the principal and amended enactments, offering detailed insight into the significant changes introduced by the Benami Transactions (Prohibition) Amendment Act, 2016.
The book explains how the law has become more effective in combating benami transactions by meticulously examining each provision with support from judicial precedents and relevant rules, explaining legal intricacies in simple and clear language.
The author also provides valuable insights on the robust mechanism relating to the confiscation and management of benami properties, and the procedural framework for inquiry, adjudication, and appeal of cases.
This book is a valuable resource for practitioners, enforcement officers, judges, legislators, policy-makers, academicians, and research scholars.

title: Corporate Sustainability Heroes
author: Jatinder Singh
subject: BGR
description:
Corporate Sustainability Heroes delves deep into the inspiring stories of 15 exceptional organizations and individuals who are leading the charge in championing corporate sustainability initiatives.
These trailblazers, motivated by the firm belief that sustainability is essential for the well-being of both society and organizations, have made remarkable advancements in a variety of fields.
Through their dedicated efforts, they have demonstrated that meaningful change is not only possible but also begins with the actions of a single person.
Their journeys highlight a powerful message: change starts with one individual, and that individual could be someone like YOU.

title: Balance Sheet of the Soul
author: C A Alok Misra
subject: BGR
description:
“Balance Sheet of The Soul“ by Alok Misra, is a story that encapsulates the essence of hard work, education, and the relentless pursuit of dreams. This book is a valuable addition to the works that are designed to inspire and uplift readers from all walks of life.

In this heartfelt memoir, I, Alok Misra, invite you to walk alongside me through the pivotal moments of my life.
