title: Handbook on Comparative IPR Law Technology Law and Emerging Legal Domains
author: Prof (Dr) Aditya Tomar, Dr Joshua Aston, Mini Srivastava, Rupendra Singh
subject: Law
description:
Offers readers an in-depth understanding of various aspects of IPR law in relation to the shifting paradigm with the emergence of technology and AI.
Delves into how the conventional understanding of IPR has developed over time and led to an inseparable union with technology.
Highlights the progression and integration of these fields, demonstrating how they have collectively shaped the modern legal landscape.
Also explores the realms of Artificial Intelligence and Cyber Laws, with a particular focus on data privacy regulations.
Equips legal practitioners, scholars, and enthusiasts with the knowledge necessary to address the challenges and opportunities presented by technological advancements.

title: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023: The New Era of Evidence Law
author: Dr K K Khandelwal
subject: Law
description:
Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023: The New Era of Evidence Law presents a comprehensive analysis of the intricacies of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023, which has replaced the Indian Evidence Act, 1872. This section-wise commentary systematically dissects each new provision highlighting their practical implications. Each provision is supported with judicial precedents and case studies based on hypothetical scenarios, explaining the legal nuances in a
lucid language.
The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 (BSA) marks a significant transformation in the Indian legal landscape. This book offers a clear and practical approach, making it an essential resource for practitioners, enforcement officers, judges, academicians, and research scholars.

title: Artificial Intelligence and Constitutionalism: The Challenges in Law
author: Shruti Bedi
subject: Law
description:
The volume explores the significant impact of AI within the legal sphere. It is organized into two main sections: ‘Interplay of AI and Constitutionalism,’ which offers comprehensive discussions on broader principles, and ‘Critical Legal Concerns,’ which focuses on specific practical themes. Various authors contribute to these sections, covering a diverse array of topics related to AI. This structure keeps readers engaged and informed about the complexities AI introduces to the legal landscape.

The authors analyze existing legal frameworks and suggest innovative strategies that align with constitutional values, ensuring the responsible and ethical use of AI technologies. Contributions from scholars in the United States and Canada enhance this discussion, offering comparative insights that emphasize both common challenges and distinct contextual factors.

title: Capital Taxation Law and Practice
author: P V Srinivasan
subject: Tax
description:
Capital Taxation: Law and Practice is an exhaustive commentary on the subject, offering an in-depth analysis of the concept and regulatory framework governing the taxation of capital in all its forms in India and other jurisdictions across the globe.
Taxation of capital is older than the taxation of income. While the income of a fiscal year is often seen as an increase in wealth, capital taxation has sparked more controversy than other types of tax. Meagre revenue yields, the subjective base of the levy, unpredictability of the event of taxation are a few reasons for its repeated repeal and reintroduction. This is in addition to the traditional concerns of tax avoidance and a plethora of exemptions that are more pronounced in capital taxation. Nevertheless, several countries have capital taxation currently in force.
This book is divided into two parts, Part A deals with the genres of capital taxation, their salient features, the history and evolution of wealth transfer tax, and the design principles; and Part B covers capital taxation regimes in some of the other countries. Policymakers, academicians, tax practitioners, and high net worth individuals are sure to find the book handy.

title: 75 Years of the Constitution - Supreme Court's Role in Promoting Constitutionalism
author: V Sudhish Pai
subject: Law
description:
75 Years of the Constitution - Supreme Court's Role in Promoting Constitutionalism marks the commemoration of 75 years of our Constitution and the Supreme Court. It offers a captivating account of the journey of the foundational document of the world’s largest democracy. It explores the Constitution’s evolution, its salient features and provisions, and the Supreme Court’s role in expounding its true meaning and intent, including the principles applied in its interpretation.

The book showcases the role and contribution of the Court in endeavouring to make the constitutional vision a reality, fostering a constitutional culture, and enforcing checks and balances within the constitutional framework, as well as examining some of the infirmities in its judgments. A critical appraisal of the Court’s work is essential for presenting a true and coherent picture of the law.

The book is structured in three parts, offering not only a theoretical jurisprudential setting but also its application to concrete cases - the judgments and the light banter - the trivia and anecdotes - which add a certain lustre.

title: Ramanujan’s Patent Law
author: Adarsh Ramanujan
subject: Law
description: Ramanujan’s Patent Law is a comprehensive and analytical commentary on the Patent Law in India. The commentary traces the legislative history of the Patents Act and the judicial precedents that have shaped the law. Written in a lucid language, the author also  delves into a comparative analysis with the legal developments in other jurisdictions, including the UK, the USA, and Canada to provide a holistic view of the law. The commentary is aimed to make the patent law accessible and easy to understand, while discussing grey areas. The readers will benefit from the author’s perspectives and views on the law. The commentary will be valuable to the practitioners, Judges, Patent Agents, Academicians and scholars.

title: The Unyielding Judge
subtitle: The Life and Legacy of Justice A.N. Grover
author: Gauri Grover
subject: Law
description: The Unyielding Judge: The Life and Legacy of Justice A.N. Grover brings to life the many dimensions of Justice A.N. Grover as a person and as a Judge of the Supreme Court. Gauri Grover, granddaughter of Justice Grover and the author of the book, has penned the narrative as a love letter to her grandfather and not merely as a chronicle of his  life and career. The author takes us through the early years and education that shaped Justice Grover as a human being, followed by his distinguished career as a lawyer and Judge. His participation in the evolution of the Basic Structure Doctrine, and the inglorious supersession that followed thereafter have been dealt in detail.  Justice Grover’s contributions to the society extended well beyond his role as a Judge, as he played a significant role in the realms of education and press rights as the Chairman of  the DPS Society and the Press Council of India. The book is a recounting of a person and a life that was enthused with conviction, a sense of duty, and a commitment to integrity.

title: UGC-NET Solved PYQs on Psychology
author: Dr Farah Shoaib
subject: Academic
description:
UGC-NET Solved PYQs on Psychology is a useful tool in the preparatory kit for the aspirants appearing for competitive examinations. The uniqueness of this book lies in the careful arrangement and presentation of previous year questions under the units prescribed in the syllabus on Psychology. Each chapter in the book is dedicated to one unit. Within the chapters as well, the questions are furthered categorised under different themes enabling the aspirants to cover the syllabus fully. The book covers questions based on the latest UGC-NET Papers for a decade, ensuring that the aspirants get a full-range of questions to practice with.

Why should you choose this book?
•	Covers over 1500+ questions on the subject.
•	Questions arranged unit-wise offering ease of revision.
•	Explanations for questions aids conceptual clarity and better retention.
•	Unique structure and arrangement of the questions ensures success in examination.
•	Author’s extensive experience is reflected in the easy language used in explanations.

title: A Treatise and Commentary on The Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 (Set of 2 Volumes)
author: K K Khandelwal
subject: Law
description:
A Treatise and Commentary on The Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 presents a comprehensive section-wise examination of the law governing the offence of money laundering in India. The commentary covers the author’s incisive analysis of the subject built on judicial precedents and a meticulous understanding of the legislative text. Delving into key concepts and frameworks  that cut across different legislation, the commentary facilitates a holistic  understanding of this intricate law and offers practical insights. It exhaustively  discusses and demystifies various aspects of the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), including investigation processes; the definition and handling of proceeds of crime; definitions and legal interpretations of money laundering offences; procedures for provisional attachment; protocols for search and seizure; arrest procedures; the application of the reverse burden of 
proof; jurisdiction and procedural norms for Special Courts; cognizance and bail of offences; requirements for summons and document production; and the evaluation of proportionality in punishments relative to the nature of scheduled offences.

The commentary will serve as a valuable guide for practitioners, judges, enforcement officers, scholars and students.

title: Sheroes Amongst Us - Real Women Real Stories
author: Falguni Desai & Dr Amit Nagpal
subject: BGR
description: Sheroes Amongst Us celebrates women who have embraced their own potential while powering through adversity to weave their own stories of success. The authors have carefully curated stories built on grit, transformation and dreams. The stories not only bring to light the accomplishments of these incredible women, but also the paths that they have traversed to reach where they are today. Each story will serve as an inspiration for aspiring women leaders of tomorrow to learn from the journeys traced in these 32 stories. This book is a call to action from the authors to awaken the Shero within you.

title: Treatise on the POSH Act - A Critical and Comparative Commentary on the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
author: Dhana Madhri Guruswamy
subject: Law
description:
Treatise on the POSH Act provides a thorough examination of the Sexual Harassment of Women at the Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition, and Redressal) Act of 2013. The book explores the history and evolution of the POSH Act, defining sexual harassment in its various forms—physical, verbal, pictorial, and virtual—while also addressing the issue of online harassment in the metaverse. It outlines the roles of Internal and Local Committees; explains the inquiry process; and discusses key provisions such as confidentiality, employer responsibilities, appeals and penalties for non-compliance. The book also discusses in detail the applicability of the POSH Act to different sectors including public sector units, education, and banking.
The book follows a topic-wise arrangement, allowing readers to easily access information and understand the nuances of law. This book will be a valuable resource for Legal Practitioners, Judges, Internal Committee members, HR Professionals, Corporate Heads, Employees, Research scholars, and anyone looking to understand the POSH Act and its implementation.

title: Yogi @ Corporate Street
author: Manish Chaturvedi
subject: BGR
description: In a world that often prioritizes competition over collaboration, this book seeks to restore the balance between ambition and empathy, individual success and team achievement. Drawing from timeless wisdom found in scriptures and moral stories, the author connects ancient narratives to the realities of modern professional life. From the resilience of Hanuman to the wisdom of Birbal, and from Bhagirath’s relentless determination to Sri Krishna’s masterful leadership, the book presents strategies, ethics, and insights applicable to today's challenges. It is an invitation to rediscover the values that drive sustainable success and meaningful leadership, and to lead with courage and collaborate with compassion. This book is about becoming a true YOGi @ Corporate Street—an individual who blends character with competence to navigate the complexities of the professional world.

title: Practitioner’s Guide to International Family Law
author: Anil Malhotra and Ankit Malhotra
subject: Law
description:
Practitioner’s Guide to International Family Law: An Indian Perspective is an authoritative and comprehensive resource that bridges the complexities of Indian family laws with the evolving challenges of international family law. Designed for practitioners, judges, academics, and students, the book addresses key issues such as cross-border marriage, divorce, child custody, maintenance, adoption, and the enforcement of foreign judgments and arbitral awards. It explores the interplay between Indian personal laws—covering Hindu, Muslim, Christian, Parsi, and secular legal frameworks like the Special Marriage Act—and international legal instruments, including the Hague Conventions and other bilateral treaties governing family law.

The book provides in-depth guidance on jurisdictional dilemmas, forum shopping, conflict of laws, and the recognition of foreign decrees under Indian law, highlighting critical provisions and contemporary case law. The book highlights significant judicial interpretations and landmark decisions, ensuring readers remain updated with the latest legal developments. By bridging domestic family law with international instruments, treaties, and comparative case studies, the guide provides solutions to complex cross-border family disputes. Further focus is given to cases involving non-resident Indians, expatriates, and cross-border families, offering clarity on topics such as habitual residence, domicile, and the enforcement of maintenance and custody orders abroad. It presents a comparative analysis of legal systems to equip readers with tools to address globalized family disputes effectively.

With its focus on harmonizing domestic and international legal principles, this guide also engages with contemporary challenges, including inter-country child abduction, international surrogacy agreements, and cross-border domestic violence. Written with procedural precision and supported by practical examples, updated citations, and legislative reforms, the book is a definitive tool for navigating international family law issues while considering India’s unique legal and cultural contexts. It is an essential reading for those seeking to understand and resolve complex, multi-jurisdictional family law matters in an increasingly interconnected and legally pluralistic world.

title: AI on Trial
author: Sujeet Kumar and Md Tauseef Alam
subject: Law
description:
AI on Trial is a forward-looking and probably the first of its kind project that examines the nexus between AI and legal systems, underlining the pressing requirement for obligation, culpability, and systems of governance. The book carefully covers AI’s key principles, culpability assignment, and legal hurdles throughout seven chapters.

In a nutshell, it analyzes biases in AI, basic rights, and the intricacies of intellectual property concerns of AI-generated content, suggesting solutions such as a “Machine-Created Intellectual Assets Act”. The book analyzes AI’s legal personhood, intentionality, and agency, calling on the Turing Test and international approaches. It also addresses models of civil and criminal liability, intermediary duties, and concerns connected to product liability.

A significant chapter oﬀers the idea of ‘safe harbour’ for AI, examining its repercussions for innovation and governance. The book finishes by examining AI’s influence on key fields such as healthcare and free speech, supporting equitable and balanced regulation.

title: Boss vs Coach: Transforming your Leadership Style
author: Mohit Khullar and Olivia Gadd
subject: BGR
description: In the rapidly evolving landscape of modern business, the shift from control to empowerment is not merely a managerial preference but a strategic imperative. The traditional boss, anchored in authority and micromanagement, may achieve compliance but often at the expense of innovation and engagement. In contrast, the coach understands that empowering team members unleashes their potential, drives creativity, and foster a resilient organizational culture. The book discusses key concepts and tools that the readers can utilise to start their journey of transformation from being a boss to a coach. The book will be of value to mid level managers, business leaders, management scholars, and everyone aspiring to elevate their leadership game.

title: Sehall’s Suspended Heart
author: Arjun Mitra
subject: BGR
description:
Mary Sehall is a normal woman with a happy family living a normal happy life and they are very very happy in their small town in the middle of nowhere and there is
absolutely nothing wrong with her very happy life. Everything is fine—better than fine. Sehall and her family—her husband, her daughter, her son—live safely within her bubble, untouchable.
Nothing can hurt them.
Nothing can break through.
As long as nothing gets in.

title: Insight into Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
author: K K Khandelwal
subject: Law
description:
Insight into Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023: A Paradigm Shift in Indian Penal Law is a comprehensive guide, providing an indispensable insight into the new legal framework. Discover the reforms introduced by the BNS, which aims to align the law with current societal values, technological advancements, and a victim-centric approach. This book meticulously dissects the provisions of the BNS, offering a clear understanding of the streamlined legal framework.

Gain a deeper understanding of
• Key changes and their implications, including the incorporation of contemporary issues like cybercrime and enhanced focus on gender justice.
• Comparative analysis with the IPC, highlighting the legislative intent and practical implications of the new code.
• The revised definitions of offences such as sedition and defamation, and the enhanced penalties for crimes against women and children.
• The inclusion of new offences like mob lynching and terrorism, and the revised approach to organised crime and public safety violations.
• The abolition of outdated provisions and the introduction of community service as a new form of punishment.
• The expansion of definitions to include economic and intangible assets as movable property.
• Detailed discussions supported by relevant case law and judicial precedents.

This book serves as a practical resource for judges, legal practitioners, enforcement officers, scholars, and students.

title: Insights into The Unified Waqf Management, Empowerment, Efficiency and Development Act, 1995
author: K K Khandelwal
subject: Law
description:
Insights into The Unified Waqf Management, Empowerment, Efficiency and Development Act, 1995 is a comprehensive commentary on the complex governance of waqf institutions in India. This Act, reimagined and restructured through the Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025, marks a watershed moment in the legal landscape of religious endowments and represents a fundamental reorientation of how waqf is envisioned. This reformative shift reflects a commitment to bringing efficiency, digitisation, and inclusivity into waqf administration.

Employing a unique multi-dimensional approach, the book meticulously analyses every section of the principal Act, explaining its essential ingredients and legal relevance with clarity. A key feature is the integrated comparative analysis with earlier versions of the Act, highlighting the nuances of the legislative changes introduced by the 2025 Amendment. Readers gain critical insights into the legislative intent through the incorporation of deliberations and discussions of the Joint Parliamentary Committee.

Enhancing its comprehensiveness and practical utility, the volume includes the full texts of vital related laws and rules, such as The Mussalman Wakf (Repeal) Act, 2025, The Central Waqf Council Rules, 1998, and The Waqf Properties Lease Rules, 2014. This ensures readers have a consolidated reference and transforms the book into a comprehensive legal toolkit for the entire legislative ecosystem governing waqf administration.

This book is an essential reference for academicians, judicial officers, policymakers, waqf administrators, legal practitioners, and the wider public seeking a deeper understanding.

title: A Commentary on the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
author: Dheera Khandelwal
subject: Law
description:
A Commentary on the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 is an extensive commentary and treatise on this vital piece of legislation, reflecting upon a pervasive issue that strikes at the very foundation of workplace ethics and the broader human rights framework. Drawing on the authors’ extensive legal expertise and administrative insight, the book delves into the nuances of the law and its practical application. It addresses not only the legal landscape but also the socio-cultural contexts that enable sexual harassment to persist, including in sectors like education, healthcare, and corporate environments.

Going beyond mere legal prescriptions, the book critically analyses the effectiveness of existing mechanisms, the challenges of implementation, and the societal attitudes that underpin the prevalence of this misconduct. It confronts the complexities of addressing sexual harassment, including distinguishing genuine cases from misrepresentations or false accusations.

Through rigorous analysis and discussion, combining detailed legal analysis with case law, this edition aims to bring clarity and insight into the Act’s provisions. It discusses various landmark judgments and critically examines the juristic approaches taken by the courts, enhancing the reader’s understanding of the Act’s impact and scope. The book also explores the intersection of the Sexual Harassment Act with other relevant legislations.

Recognising that sexual harassment in the workplace continues to be a critical issue affecting millions of women worldwide, this book is an indispensable resource for legal practitioners, policymakers, academicians, and indeed, any concerned citizen. It provides the tools and knowledge necessary to understand and fight against such injustices.

title: Legal Aptitude & Reasoning LA/LR
author: Vishrut Jain
subject: Academic
description:
Legal Aptitude & Reasoning (LA/LR) for CLAT, AILET, SLAT and Other Law Entrance Tests is a comprehensive book on legal reasoning designed for law entrance exam preparation. It comprehensively covers the syllabus and offers conceptual as well as analytical clarity on the subject.
The book meticulously guides the students on the theoretical aspects as well as practical application in the form of Primers and Passages on key subjects of law. Following the new pattern for CLAT, the passages are accompanied with questions that test the reader’s observation skills and knowledge. 

Key features
Dual Focus: Legal Aptitude & Legal Reasoning Covered in Depth
• Strategies for Test Preparation based on the New CLAT Pattern
• Clear Concepts Across Key Law Subjects – Constitutional, International, Family Law & More
• Chapter-wise Passages Based on the Latest Exam Format
• Updated with 2023 Criminal Laws - Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita & Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam
• Practice Passages with Questions, Answers & Explanations
• Self-Assessment Revision Worksheets for Exam Readiness

title: A Guide to Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
author: Prithivi Raj
subject: Law
description:
A 360o view of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 providing 
•	Comprehensive Coverage: A detailed explanation of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita
•	Conceptual Clarity: Clear explanation aimed at fostering strong conceptual clarity
•	Case law: Updated with recent and landmark case law
•	Practical tools: FIR, charge sheet, bail formats along with flowcharts
•	Illustrations: Procedural illustration to aid understanding
•	Audience: Ideal for students, practitioners, and judicial aspirants

title: Insights into The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016
author: K K Khandelwal
subject: Law
description:
Insights into The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 is a comprehensive and compelling commentary on the RERA Act. The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 (RERA) marked a transformative moment in India’s real estate governance, ushering in an era aimed at ensuring transparency, enhancing accountability, and fortifying fairness in real estate transactions. For decades before, the sector operated largely unregulated, characterised by a lack of transparency, imbalance in contractual relations, and an erosion of homebuyers’ rights.

In this crucial context, the author, a distinguished former Chairman of the Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority, Gurugram, drawing from his extensive experience which includes his pioneering role in RERA’s early implementation in Haryana, offers a meticulous and methodical exposition of each section of the Act.

This invaluable resource demystifies the law by offering profound insights into its structure, purpose, and evolving jurisprudence. The book deeply analyses intricate topics such as Supreme Court rulings on RERA, the placement of Allottees within the purview of Financial Creditors under IBC, and the crucial interface of the Consumer Protection Act and RERA. It also features an exhaustive coverage of nearly all important judgments of the Supreme Court and various High Courts up to April 2025, carefully outlining the background, core issues, and providing valuable insights into the practical application and interpretation of the Act by the judiciary.

It will serve as an invaluable resource for practitioners, adjudicators, academicians, students, policy architects, real estate developers, and all stakeholders steering the complexities of RERA.

title: Indian Polity and Governance (2/e)
author: Nirbhay Sharma
subject: Academic
description: The thoroughly revised and updated Second Edition of Indian Polity and Governance is your indispensable guide to navigating the complexities of the Indian Constitution, polity, and governance. This book seamlessly integrates foundational constitutional principles with the most recent developments, ensuring you are prepared for every stage of your civil services journey. Key Highlights of this Edition - - Comprehensive Updates: Stay current with the latest constitutional amendments, new parliamentary legislation, significant judicial decisions, and all new appointments in constitutional and statutory institutions. - Expanded Coverage: Discover crucial new chapters including ‘Law Commission of India’ ‘Enforcement Directorate’ , and ‘Accountability and Transparency’ . A new part, ‘Environment’, featuring a chapter titled ‘Environment: Constitutional Protection and Judicial Activism’, has also been added. - Strategic Study Approach: Learn how to effectively connect theoretical knowledge with current developments for Prelims, Mains, and Interview stages, utilizing newspapers and current affairs magazines. - Mains Answer Writing Mastery: Develop the capacity to craft balanced and progressive answers, incorporating constitutional provisions, current examples, and essential Supreme Court judgments. - Interview Preparation: Gain insights on correlating current affairs with static topics and developing an incisive outlook for the interview stage. - Your Path to Success: This guide is designed to transform Indian Constitution, Polity, and Governance into your strongest subject, significantly contributing to your ultimate goal of success.

title: OakBridge’s Primary Law Series Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (46 of 2023)
author: OakBridge
subject: Law
description:
This publication serves as a definitive guide to the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, furnishing an exhaustive comparative review with the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973. It is an invaluable tool for the judiciary, legal professionals, enforcement agencies, government bodies, students, and the general public.

Key Features -
- Text on Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
- Latest Case Law
- Essentials of each section highlighted
- Table showing new sections of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
- Table showing sections of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 repealed by Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
- Table showing timelines for various stages of trial
- Contextual Explanations and Interpretations

title: Story of the Clan – A Legacy Untold
author: S S Naganand
subject: Law
description: Story of the Clan – A Legend Untold brings to life the journey of an erudite and illustrious family spanning over 200 years. Narrated by the renowned Senior Advocate, SS Naganand, the author chronicles the lives of his distinguished ancestors and their contributions to the society. The book interweaves their professional, personal and spiritual lives seamlessly. Recounting episodes and incidents from his life, the author shares the lessons that have been instrumental in his professional success as well as personal & spiritual harmony. Written in an anecdotal and lucid style, the narrative is both informative as well as engaging. The book comprises experiences relating to myriad subjects including history, law, travel, spirituality, and traditions. It is fascinating to see the thread of values that runs through the different generations in the family that has paved way for advancements in life while being firmly grounded. The story that is unfolded will inspire many, from different walks of life, especially the young generation, who can imbibe the life lessons in the book towards a harmonious, holistic and successful life.

title: Protection of Trademarks: A Glimpse of Landmark Judgments
author:
Arvind P Bhanu
Prabhdeep Kaur Malhotra
subject: Law
description:
Protection of Trademarks: A Glimpse of Landmark Judgments delves deeply into the pivotal judgments shaping trademark law. The book meticulously navigates the intricate legal landscapes governing trademark protection, shedding light on landmark decisions that have shaped and continue to influence jurisprudence. The book offers a comparative perspective on how different legal systems address similar challenges. It underscores the evolving nature of trademark law as it grapples with the challenges posed by globalization, technological advancements, and the digital economy.
The book explores a wide array of diverse and timely topics including the protection of non-conventional marks and trade dress, comparative advertising, the concept of deceptive similarity, and trademark infringement in the digital age. The book also addresses emerging issues such as cybersquatting, the role of blockchain technology, and the intersection of cultural heritage with trademark rights. Authored by seasoned professionals, scholars, and practitioners in the field, this book is an invaluable resource for understanding the complexities of trademark protection in an increasingly interconnected and digitalized world. An essential read for legal practitioners, academics, policymakers, students, and business professionals.

title: The Art of Legal Writing (2/e)
author: Richa Kacchwaha
subject: Law
description:
The Art of Legal Writing (Practicing Lawyers to Successful Professionals), first published in 2019, was meant to help young lawyers and law students make an impact with their writing. Understanding how the human mind absorbs information and applying those principles while writing were the key takeaways of the book. Given the lack of literature in India on the art and nuances of legal writing, the book attempted to fill the void. In recent years, the buzz around the evolving role of technology in legal practice has gained traction. The pace and extent to which technology is making an impact on the practice of law, particularly the developments in Artificial Intelligence (AI) legal tools, demands a new discussion. These advancements, their potential to alter the practice of law, as well as the pitfalls of over dependence on deep technology, have been extensively discussed in a new chapter introduced in this edition titled “Artificial Intelligence in Law: A Turning Point or Hype.” The author maintains the fine balance between the potential of AI to transform the practice of law and its limitations in handling critical legal work without lawyers’ supervision.
This second edition will be valuable for lawyers and legal professionals looking to leverage AI to enhance efficiency without lowering the quality and integrity of their legal work.

title: The Journey To The Earth of A Star
author: Garvika Mittal
subject: BGR
description: A star curious about humans, and their thoughts about stars sets out for an adventure to the earth after reading about it from a book. Will the star be able to go to earth? Will it be able to get answers to his questions?

title: Social Justice (2/e)
author: Naveen Kumar Chandra
subject: Academic
description:
Social Justice: An Overview of the Indian Landscape is an indispensable guide to navigate the complexities of social justice in India’s diverse and dynamic socio-political context. Designed specifically for aspirants of the UPSC Civil Services Examination (CSE) and scholars of Indian society, governance, and social justice, this comprehensive resource offers a structured exploration of key themes shaping India’s social fabric. This edition covers critical issues including caste, gender, religion, ethnicity, poverty, and governance, each supported by detailed analyses of legal frameworks, constitutional provisions, and landmark policies.

Discover - 
- Up-to-date International Rankings: Analyse India’s progress and challenges in global indices like the Human Development Index (HDI) and Gender Inequality Index (GII), along with specific insights into gender disparities and environmental challenges.
- Authoritative National Data: Access data from national reports on domestic violence prevalence, annual migration figures, female labour force participation, and policy impacts like MGNREGA’s reach and POSH Act compliance.
- Strategic Answer-Writing Tools: Learn to draft nuanced, multidimensional answers for UPSC Mains based on precise data points, co-relating it with constitutional provisions & policies, and incorporating recent events and case law.
- Previous Years’ Questions: Includes previous years’ questions with indicative pointers to practice answer-writing.

Whether grappling with persistent challenges like caste-based discrimination and gender inequality, or understanding strides in poverty reduction and policy innovation, this book empowers you to engage critically with contemporary issues. It is more than just a resource; it is a valuable companion for those committed to understanding and advancing a more equitable and inclusive India.

title: Insight into the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (set of 2 vols)
author: K K Khandelwal
subject: Law
description: Insight into the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 - A Comprehensive Commentary & Analysis provides an indispensable guide to understanding and navigating this pivotal new legislation. The author brings his vast administrative experience and a practical viewpoint on implementing such sweeping reforms, and dissects complex provisions, making them accessible to a diverse audience. Replacing the outdated Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC), the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS) introduces crucial advancements, including the integration of electronic communication for legal processes, defined timelines for proceedings, provisions for trials in absentia, extended police custody with justification, and updated protocols for electronic evidence handling. It aims to foster a more just, efficient, and transparent criminal justice process by incorporating modern technology and reducing reliance on colonial-era laws. This comprehensive work meticulously explores the BNSS's thirty-nine chapters and 531 sections, organized into eighty thematic units to enhance coherence and clarity. It offers a vital comparative analysis with the former CrPC, highlighting what is new or altered, and incorporates relevant case laws to provide practical insights into how these laws are likely to be interpreted and applied. It is an essential read for practicing lawyers, legal academicians, members of the police and judiciary, law students, policymakers, scholars, and any citizen keen to understand the profound changes reshaping India's legal landscape. It serves as a definitive resource for navigating the complexities of this reform, enriching understanding, and inspiring thoughtful engagement with the future of law and justice in India.

title: Environment and Ecology With Disaster Management 5/e
author: R Rajagopalan
subject: Academic
description:
A Complete Guide on Environment, Ecology and Disaster Management for the Civil Services Preliminary and Main Examinations as well as the Indian Forest Service Examination.

Exhaustive Coverage including concepts, policies, agreements and conventions
Question-Answer format aids exam oriented preparation
Fully solved questions from 2025 Prelims
Bullet points help retention of key points
Suggested Strategy based on Question Papers from 2011-25
Exhaustive Coverage True Stories facilitate conceptual understanding
Critical Thinking inculcated to stand out in the competition
Effective Study based on SQ4R Method
Current Affairs on Scroll Stack - https://profrr.stck.me/

title: Unfiltered and Unapologetic
author: Shilpa Bhasin Mehra
subject: BGR
description:
Unfiltered and Unapologetic invites you to engage with words intended to offer something meaningful, resonant, and inspiring. Perhaps you, too, will uncover something new about yourself within these pages.

Spanning diverse topics that impact everyone in their daily lives, the book delves into essential areas including Interpersonal Communication and Relationships, Personal Growth & Self-Empowerment, Social Etiquette and Norms, Perspective and Reflection on Life, and Workplace Dynamics and Professionalism. Though varied in theme, each piece is united by a central question: How can we navigate this world with grace, purpose, kindness, and authenticity?

A powerful collection of articles, born from a journey shaped by personal experience and a deep passion for writing. What began as a lifeline during rehabilitation from viral meningitis in 2003 blossomed into a career by chance, with articles previously shared with a global audience. Inspired by both individual challenges and collective experiences like the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, this book brings together writings that reflect the author’s own struggles, triumphs questions, and discoveries, interwoven with wisdom from others.

title: Q&A: Part 1: Indian Art and Culture
author: OakBridge
subject: Academic
description:
Q&A Series Part 1 – Indian Art and Culture has been written for the aspirants of Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination. It will also help the students in the preparation of various state services examinations.

Keeping in view the new syllabi and the changing trends of Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination, the book provides practice questions on the various topics of Indian Art and Culture.

These questions are in consonance with the latest pattern of the UPSC. In order to develop a comprehensive insight on the topics, each chapter is followed by an elaborate explanation of the questions provided in that chapter. Explanations have been written in a manner to help the aspirants to tackle the other questions related to the topic.

Key features :-
- Provides topic-wise practice questions
- Provides detailed solutions to the questions
- Based on the latest pattern of the Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination
- Presents additional practice set on the subject, for the purpose of self-assessment

The series comprises eight practice workbooks related to the various subjects mentioned in the syllabus of CSE. These books provide questions, along with their solutions, on the various topics of the subjects, to make the students thorough with the pattern of Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination.

Q&A Series has been written as an adjunct to our General Studies Series. Hence, it is mapped to the eight books of General Studies series. The idea is to aid the self-assessment process, once the aspirant has gone through the eight books of General Studies Series.
The book has been prepared by the Content Team of Oakbridge under the guidence of faculties.

title: Handbook for Executive Magistrates
subtitle: Powers Functions, Procedures & Practice
author: K K Khandelwal
subject: Law
description:
Handbook for Executive Magistrates aims to fill a long-standing void for a comprehensive and structured reference work concerning the roles, responsibilities, and powers of Executive Magistrates. The book comes at a critical juncture as Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS) replaces the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

Spanning over ten parts and forty-five chapters, the book provides an exhaustive exposition of law, practice, and jurisprudence applicable to Executive Magistrates. It covers every significant dimension of their role, including appointment, statutory powers, and quasi-judicial functions in areas such as preventive justice, security proceedings, inquests, dying declarations, and test identification parades. The book also delves into other crucial areas including the maintenance of public order, control of public nuisance, defamation, contempt, and disciplinary jurisdiction.

The book is designed to be a handbook focusing on practical applicability. It achieves this by interspersing legal theory with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), actionable checklists, and ready-to-use formats for drafting orders and conducting proceedings. Covering landmark and critical case law, the book simplifies complex procedural requirements and offers conceptual clarity.

The book will be a valuable manual for young officers, experienced administrators, academicians, trainers, public prosecutors, and senior civil servants.

title: In Search of Courtroom Ethics
author: Dr B S Patil
subject: Law
description:
"No part of the law can be learnt exclusively through study – practise is always essential". This profound truth lies at the heart of In Search of Courtroom Ethics, a unique part-memoir and part-guide-book that boldly addresses the familiar conflict between personal morality and professional ethics faced by every lawyer.
Drawing inspiration from illuminating incidents like Sir Edward Marshall Hall's refusal to shake an acquitted client's hand—a gesture not "included in the etiquette of the Bar"—this book masterfully weaves compelling narratives around vital legal principles. Readers will follow "the Tusker," the author’s well-earned moniker reflecting their plain-speaking and adherence to the straight path of the law, gaining invaluable, non-textbook insight into the intricacies of the Indian legal system.
Through thoughtful meditations and entertaining anecdotes "ripped straight out of the strange and wonderful world of the trial courts," the author explores the nuanced interplay of duty, morality, skill, and deference crucial for a successful legal career. This is a book crafted not to spoon-feed information, but to encourage independent thought and create knowledge, leaving readers with questions that foster their own rumination.
For practising lawyers, it offers a deep reflection on their craft; for law students, a forearmed glimpse into their future; and for the general reader, a fascinating window into the oftenopaque world of justice. As the author states, ethics are not taught in classrooms but are "imparted through conduct, not instruction; through example and inspiration".

title: Bailed Out! Precept & Practice of Bail Jurisprudence
author: N Vijayaraghavan and Sharath Chandran
subject: Law
description:
Bailed Out! Precept & Practice of Bail Jurisprudence offers a comprehensive and assertive exploration of law of bail—an area of law that shapes the balance between liberty and justice. The book is based on the principle that "bail is the rule, jail is the exception". It connects this principle to the fundamental rights of life and liberty, rooted in the presumption of innocence, which states that an individual is considered innocent until proven guilty.
The book traces its journey from the debates of the Constituent Assembly to the pressing challenges of today. It provides detailed insights into critical areas such as the principles of arrest and remand, the complexities of anticipatory bail, and the unique considerations for bail in economic offences, including those under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act. Additionally, it courageously addresses the "Psychology and Trauma of the Jailed," advocating for systemic changes rather than superficial legal reforms to tackle the dilemmas within bail jurisprudence effectively.
It is an indispensable resource for law students, practitioners, policy makers, and anyone concerned with the protection of personal liberty in a just society.

title: Insight into the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025
author: K K Khandelwal
subject: Law
description:
he Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025 is a landmark law that confronts this challenge head-on. This timely and rigorous guide offers an essential map to the Act’s balanced architecture—promoting what builds skill and community, while prohibiting what harms families and the financial system.

This book provides a clear, practice-ready framework for one of India’s most dynamic sectors. It meticulously unpacks the Act’s “bright line” approach: enabling and professionalising e-sports and safe social games while comprehensively banning stake-based “online money games” along with their advertising and payment channels.

Inside, you will discover

A Clear Operational Guide: Translate complex statutory language into actionable checklists and compliance playbooks for developers, platforms, investors, and payment intermediaries.
Comprehensive Prohibition Architecture: Understand the complete ban on offering, advertising, and funding online money games, and the robust enforcement powers designed to close offshore loopholes and tackle illicit finance risks.
Pathways for Growth and Innovation: Learn how the Act creates a stable legal environment to promote e-sports as a legitimate competitive sport and encourages the development of safe, age-appropriate social and educational games.
Institutional Framework Explained: Gain insight into the role of the National Online Gaming Authority, the calibrated penalties for offenses, and the due-process safeguards that ensure fair and transparent implementation.

title: Balance Sheet of the Soul (2/e)
author: Alok Misra
subject: BGR
description:
"Balance Sheet of The Soul“ by Alok Misra, is a story that encapsulates the essence of hard work, education, and the relentless pursuit of dreams. This book is a valuable addition to the works that are designed to inspire and uplift readers from all walks of life.

In this heartfelt memoir, I, Alok Misra, invite you to walk alongside me through the pivotal moments of my life. From the lessons learned at my family’s dining table to the entrepreneurial ventures that shaped my career, I hope my story inspires you to pursue your dreams with passion and perseverance. This book is a tribute to Mahavatar Babaji, Grihastha Yogi & my ideal Sri Sri Lahiri Mahasaya, Swami Sri Yukteswar Giri Ji & Gurudev Sri Sri Paramahansa Yogananda, my Grandparents, Parents, Parent-in-laws, Wife (Sunaina), Son (Anand).

title: Mastering Governance, Leadership, & Strategic Storytelling
author: Dr Amit Nagpal
subject: BGR
description:
In a world brimming with noise, data, and distractions, the ability to communicate clearly and inspire action is the ultimate superpower for any leader.

Mastering Governance, Leadership, and Strategic Storytelling unlocks this transformative power, drawing profound insights from the journey and communication mastery of Prime Minister Narendra Modi. From his humble beginnings as a tea vendor to becoming a global statesman, PM Modi’s story demonstrates how vision, relentless effort, and exceptional communication can shape national conversations and foster movements.

This essential guide goes beyond conventional branding, revealing the profound truth that ‘Bonding is more powerful than Branding’. Discover how to connect people not just to your message, but to you, building trust that serves as the real currency of leadership.

Inside, you'll find a practical blueprint for influence, featuring:

The 7E Framework for Strategic Storytelling: Learn to embody Empathy, foster Emotional Connect, deliver Edutainment, practice Evocation, master Eloquence, be Energizing, and engage on Multiple Platforms—strategies that win hearts and shape minds.
Checklists and Real-World Cases: Each chapter provides tactical steps and examples from PM Modi's high-stakes communication, showing how to transform policies into purpose and strategy into shared accomplishment.
Self-Reflection Tools: Uncover your own unique stories and experiences to become a more authentic and compelling communicator.
Whether you are a CEO, business leader, entrepreneur, social changemaker, or an aspiring executive, this book is your toolkit to cut through jargon, energize teams, attract talent, and mobilize diverse audiences. Learn to elevate your governance, build enduring trust, and leave a lasting legacy.

The world doesn’t just need more leaders; it needs more leaders with heart. Read on, reflect, and reimagine your own story – the world is waiting for your message.

title: Guardians of the Boardroom: A Strategic Guide To Boardroom Excellence, Ethical Leadership, And Risk Oversight
author: Dr Tania Dehury
subject: BGR
description:
In an era where trust, transparency, and accountability define corporate success, Guardians of the Boardroom: A Strategic Guide to Boardroom Excellence, Ethical Leadership, and Risk Oversight stands as a definitive call to action for modern corporate governance.

This landmark book explores the evolving role of Independent Directors - the sentinels of integrity who safeguard the conscience of corporate India. Through vivid case studies, eleven insightful chapters, and the Board Oversight Toolkit and Key Questions, it reveals how boardroom independence can move from principle to practice - from mere compliance to true conscience.

Covering critical dimensions of modern governance, the chapters include:

1. The Multifaceted Role of Independent Directors – Balancing committee duties and board responsibilities
2. The Owl in the Boardroom – Embodying wisdom and vigilance in corporate governance
3. Satyam, Shivam, Sundaram – A moral compass for ethical decision-making
4. Independent Directors in Crisis – Navigating corporate scandals, risk management, and high-stakes decisions
5. The Invisible Backbone – Questioning true independence in promoter-driven boards
6. Independent by Title, Dependent by Design – The illusion of autonomy in Indian boardrooms
7. Stewards of Sustainability – Expanding fiduciary duties in ESG and long-term value creation
8. Women Directors as Champions of ESG – Driving diversity, equity, and sustainability
9. Tone from the Top – Why boardroom ethics begin with Independent Directors
10. Tech, Trust, and Transparency – The digital governance challenge
11. Guardians of Tomorrow – Building the next generation of purpose-driven directors
12. Lessons from the Boardroom – Ten case studies illuminating governance in action
13. Board Oversight Toolkit and Key Questions – Strengthening governance and ensuring effective oversight across committees
Blending philosophy with pragmatism, Guardians of the Boardroom redefines what it means to lead with purpose, question with integrity, and govern with wisdom. A must-read for directors, regulators, scholars, and governance professionals seeking to elevate the moral and strategic fabric of India's boardrooms.

title: Pet Care Made Easy
author: Dr Gautam Unny
subject: BGR
description: From choosing the right puppy or kitten to providing lifelong care, Pet Care Made Easy is an indispensable companion for every pet parent. Drawing on decades of veterinary experience, the author simplifies the science and art of pet care—making it approachable, practical, and deeply compassionate. The book takes readers through the fascinating history of domestication, the diversity of breeds, and the essentials of health, nutrition, training, and behaviour. With detailed guidance on selecting the right pet for your lifestyle, ensuring proper veterinary care, and creating a safe, happy environment, this book helps you navigate every stage of your pet’s life with confidence. Enriched with real-life anecdotes, expert insights, and easy-to-follow advice, Pet Care Made Easy celebrates the joy and responsibility of sharing your life with animals. Whether you are a first-time owner or a lifelong pet lover, this book will become your trusted guide to raising healthy, affectionate, and well-adjusted companions.

title: Tales of Wagging Tails
author: Dr Gautam Unny
subject: BGR
description:
Step into the world of veterinary medicine with Dr. Gautam Unny, who shares his three decades of experience treating animals ranging from white mice to Indian elephants. In Tales of Wagging Tails, he recounts the emotional highs and lows of his journey, navigating both the joy and sorrow that come with caring for "the purest of God’s creations."

Discover the unforgettable "theatrical or dramebaaz patients" who are "nothing short of comic actors with a spirit of their own." Meet remarkable animal patients such as Romeo, a 70 kg St. Bernard who loves chest thumps and biscuits, and Boxy, the mischievous boxer who can open doors and operate the air conditioner.

Dr. Unny also addresses the moral dilemmas that veterinarians face, such as euthanasia and performing emergency surgeries on unusual objects. This book aims to inspire young veterinarians to pursue their dreams while embracing the challenges of their profession.

title: In Service of the Nation
subtitle: Reflections of a Bureaucrat
author: Pratap Singh
subject: BGR
description:
In Service of the Nation: Reflections of a Bureaucrat is a compelling memoir that traces Pratap Singh’s remarkable journey from a small, electricity-deficient village in Uttar Pradesh to the highest ranks of India’s civil services. Set against the backdrop of India’s economic and administrative transformation, the book offers a rare, ground-level view of how public institutions—especially the tax administration—have shaped the nation’s progress.

With honesty and clarity, he recounts his experiences across major postings in Kanpur, Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Gurgaon, and Chennai, revealing the challenges, investigations, reforms, and innovations that define life within the Indian Revenue Service. His insights illuminate how India built stronger systems, embraced technology, and strengthened financial integrity during a crucial phase of national growth.

Interwoven with this professional narrative is an inspiring personal story—one that demonstrates how perseverance, education, and opportunity can lift individuals from modest rural beginnings to the country’s most esteemed institutions, including AMU and IIT Kanpur.

Reflective and deeply human, In Service of the Nation is a testament to integrity, purpose, and an unwavering commitment to nation-building at a time when India’s moment has truly arrived.

title: The Law Relating to The Code on Social Security, 2020: With Draft Central Rules, Notifications and Judgments
author: Saji Narayanan C K
subject: Law
description:
•	The Law Relating to the Code on Social Security, 2020 is a comprehensive and authoritative examination of a historic reform that marks India’s bold stride toward universal social security. 

•	Consolidating and amending nine central labour laws—including landmark schemes such as the Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) and Employees’ State Insurance (ESI)—the Code streamlines and modernizes the country’s social security architecture.

•	This extensive volume offers meticulous, section-by-section analysis of key areas such as EPF, ESI, Gratuity, Maternity Benefit, and Employee’s Compensation. 

•	The Code significantly expands social protection by extending coverage to Unorganised Workers, Gig Workers, and Platform Workers, with provisions mandating aggregator contributions to the Social Security Fund based on annual turnover. 

•	The book also incorporates the latest Draft Central Rules and Notifications for ready reference.

•	Rich with distilled insights from important Supreme Court and High Court judgments—particularly valuable where the Code mirrors earlier laws—this commentary serves as an indispensable resource for the legal fraternity, labour courts and tribunals, HR professionals, trade unions, employer organisations, and academia seeking clarity on the evolving framework of social security in India.

title: The Law Relating to The Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020: With Draft Central Rules, Notifications and Judgments
author: Saji Narayanan C K
subject: Law
description:
•	The Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 (OSH & WC Code) represents a watershed reform in India’s labour framework. 

•	By consolidating thirteen diverse labour laws and reducing 622 provisions into a streamlined set of 134, the Code ushers in a modern, coherent structure for safeguarding workplace safety and well-being. 

•	It extends occupational safety and health requirements to nearly all establishments employing ten or more workers—including those in the service sector—and applies these protections universally wherever hazardous or life threatening activities are undertaken.

•	Strengthening worker rights at their core, the Code makes it mandatory for employers to issue appointment letters and empowers every employee to participate actively in improving safety and health standards at the workplace.

•	The Law Relating to the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 provides an exhaustive, section-wise commentary enriched with decisions from courts across India. 

•	The book also includes a detailed comparative chart juxtaposing the Code’s provisions with the repealed laws, offering valuable clarity on the transition to the new regime. 

•	Comprehensive and authoritative, this volume is an indispensable resource for judges, lawyers, corporate management, students, and trade union leaders seeking to navigate India’s transformed occupational safety and working conditions landscape.

title: The Law Relating to The Industrial Relations Code, 2020: With Draft Central Rules, Orders, Notifications and Judgments
author: Saji Narayanan C K
subject: Law
description:
•	The Law Relating to Industrial Relations Code, 2020 is a comprehensive volume that offers an authoritative and contemporary examination of one of India’s most far-reaching labour reforms. 

•	The Industrial Relations Code, 2020 consolidates and modernizes three foundational laws—the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947; the Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 1946; and the Trade Unions Act, 1926—streamlining the industrial relations framework for a rapidly evolving, technology-driven economy.

•	The Code introduces several progressive changes, including single registration for establishments, rationalized thresholds for lay-off and retrenchment, fixed-term employment, and strengthened frameworks for trade unions, dispute settlement, and worker grievance redressal. 

•	It also establishes a unified Industrial Tribunal with the power to grant interim relief and creates a Worker Re-Skilling Fund to support retrenched employees. 

•	With clear, section-wise analysis enriched by the essence of key judicial decisions, this book serves as an indispensable guide for legal professionals, HR practitioners, employers, and academics seeking a deep understanding of the Industrial Relations Code, 2020 and its practical implications.

title: The Law Relating to The Code on Wages, 2019: With Draft Central Rules, Notifications and Judgments
author: Saji Narayanan C K
subject: Law
description:
•	The Law Relating to The Code on Wages, 2019 delivers a meticulous, section-wise commentary enriched with judicial pronouncements, constitutional insights, and practical perspectives.

•	The Code on Wages, 2019 represents a defining moment in India’s labour law landscape, bringing together four foundational statutes - the Payment of Wages Act, 1936; Minimum Wages Act, 1948; Payment of Bonus Act, 1965; and Equal Remuneration Act, 1976 into a unified, modern framework.

•	Designed to promote livelihood security, productive employment, and equitable growth, the Code reshapes wage regulation for the nation’s workforce.

•	Extending minimum wage protection to nearly all employees, including those in supervisory and managerial roles, the Code introduces a pioneering statutory floor wage that no State may breach. 

•	It widens the scope of “wage” to cover key allowances and strengthens social justice by expanding the claim limitation period from six months to three years and enforcing strict gender-neutrality across recruitment and employment conditions.

•	Comprehensive and authoritative, this volume is an essential resource for policymakers, legal professionals, trade unions, HR leaders, and anyone seeking to navigate India’s transformed wage ecosystem.

title: Compulsory English for IAS (Mains) Examination 6/e
author: A P Bhardwaj
subject: Academic
description: With a distinguished track record of 16 years as #1 NATIONAL BESTSELLER, A P Bhardwaj’s COMPULSORY ENGLISH 6th Edition has been completely revised and revamped, featuring section-wise solved papers of IAS (MAINS) 2024-2025. This new edition brings: Comprehensive updates added to the Grammar, Vocabulary, and Composition sections. All sections now include solved questions from the 2024-2025 IAS Mains exams, covering key areas such as Precis, Comprehension, Errors, Grammar, and Vocabulary. A brand-new chapter featuring 4500 synonyms and antonyms, presented in a fresh format with roots and meanings of parent words for better understanding and retention. Two new parts, consisting of 12 chapters on Usage of Grammar and Vocabulary, offering 200 additional Practice Tests (PTs) to further enhance mastery. Fully solved Language paper of DELHI JUDICIAL SERVICES EXAMINATION (DJSE), 2023

title: Mastering the Essay Paper
author: Naveen Kumar Chandra
subject: Academic
description: The UPSC Civil Services Examination (CSE) Essay Paper, carrying 250 marks, is a pivotal component that shapes an aspirant’s journey toward becoming a civil servant and serving India’s vision. Scoring highly demands more than mere knowledge; it requires the ability to articulate ideas with clarity, coherence, and multi-dimensional insight.Mastering the Essay Paper is designed to empower you to meet these demands. Crafted with insights from past UPSC papers (2015–2024) and proven toppers’ strategies, it provides a comprehensive roadmap for excellence in essay writing.Find the definitive systematic guidance needed to excel:• Structure for Success: Learn to transform complex topics into compelling narratives, mastering structured writing and evidence-based arguments.• Topper-Driven Content: Benefit from 60 sample essays on past UPSC topics, showcasing detailed multi-dimensional analysis. Gain insights from toppers and examiners, emphasizingclarity, originality, and solutions.• Evidence-Based Authority: Ensure your arguments are high-impact by eﬀectively integrating current aﬀairs. Learn how to leverage credible sources like NFHS-5, Economic Surveys, andCOP29, and embed statistics using sources like The Hindu and PIB.• Precision Practice: Prepare for the rigorous 3-hour, two-essay format with 30 practice questions and model outlines. Learn to tackle common pitfalls—such as time mismanagement or deviation.• Essential Tools & Resources: Access to 150-word vocabulary, 100 key statistics for 2024–2025, a 50-term glossary, and the interactive Digital Companion Portal.Transform your words into scores. Shape your destiny as a civil servant.

title: International Relations and Foreign Policy of India
author: Naveen Kumar Chandra
subject: Academic
description: International Relations and Foreign Policy of India, through its unique content structure and simple writing style, intends to help aspirants consolidate their learning and preparation on the subject as well as sharpen their focus to help them succeed.The book connects the theoretical foundations of International Relations with its practical application through India’s experiences, which acts as a crucial base for understanding India’s emergence as a nuclear power and a cultural beacon in a dynamic world. It is designed to oﬀer a comprehensive lens for those seeking to master the complexities of India’s role in global politics. The book provides several useful frameworks and tools to aid the aspirants in their preparation including Case Studies, Answer-writing Strategies for Mains, Sample Questions for Prelims and Mains, and Previous Year Questions’ Analysis.Providing a comprehensive analysis of India’s foreign policy, which is fundamentally shaped by the philosophical ideals of Mahatma Gandhi’s non-violence and the leaders of Independent India, the book explores how these historical roots underpin India’s modern diplomatic strategies. In the process it traces the evolution of India’s stance through distinct phases, from the anti-imperialist solidarity of the pre-independence era to the strategic multi-alignment of the 21st century.In the book, you will study the core concepts that define India’s global presence:• Strategic Autonomy: Examine India’s balancing act, exemplified by its deepened ties with the United States while maintaining a robust defense partnership with Russia.• Sovereignty and Security: Analyse India’s firm stance against violations of its borders.• Global Leadership: Chart India’s ascent as a leader of the Global South, highlighted by its successful 2023 G20 presidency, its prominent role in the QUAD framework, and its pioneering International Solar Alliance (ISA) initiative.• Soft Power and Influence: Understand how India leverages its cultural diplomacy, and economic integration through massive exports and trade pacts.The book aims to equip civil services aspirants with the ability to critically analyse and relate contemporary developments in International Relations, all of which will aid the success of the aspirants.

title: Day 1 to One Day
author: Naveen Kumar Chandra
subject: Academic
description: Day 1 to One Day is the essential, comprehensive guide designed to help you master the final and most defining stage of the UPSC Civil Services Examination (CSE)—the Personality Test. More than a mere assessment of knowledge, the Interview is an opportunity to showcase your personality, clarity of thought, and commitment to serving the nation.

title: Fun-in-Law
author: Raju Z Moray
subject: BGR
description: This book provides a step-by-step roadmap for aspirants at all stages, integrating interview preparation with your Prelims and Mains study from the very beginning. You will learn how to strategically fill your Detailed Application Form (DAF), which acts as the foundation of your interview and defines your personal narrative.

title: A Treatise on the Black Money Act of India – Law Practice & Jurisprudence
author: CA T P Ostwal and CA Kush Vatsaraj
subject: Law
description: Inside, you will find practical strategies, sample questions with high-scoring model answers, mind maps, and checklists to ensure full readiness. The content systematically guides you through tackling personal, current aﬀairs, situational, and tricky questions, helping you showcase decision-making and ethical judgment.

title: Perspectives from and within India and its Neighbourhood
author: Shishir Priyadarshi & Dr Cchavi Vasisht
subject: BGR
description: The core approach is simple: blend thorough preparation with authenticity. The book teaches you how to present your true self while aligning your experiences with the qualities of a future civil servant—leadership, empathy, and ethical judgment. Discover how to build the confidence and resilience required  to excel.

title: The Union of States: Contemporary Political History of India’s Federal Challenges
author: Nirmalkumar Mohandoss
subject: BGR
description:
Is India’s federal promise quietly being reshaped?
The Union of States opens with a close and thoughtful examination of how India’s constitutional design is evolving in practice. With clarity and balance, this contemporary account traces the “march of law” as the relationship between the Union and its States encounters new tests. It revisits key episodes—from changes in elected governments in Arunachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand to administrative stalemates in Puducherry, the reorganisation of Jammu and Kashmir, and the expanding reach of national policies into areas long managed by the States. By bringing together legal developments and lived constitutional experiences, the book invites readers to reflect on how federal principles operate beyond theory. What does autonomy mean in a complex Union?
How are responsibilities shared, negotiated, and redefined? In raising these questions, the opening sets the stage for a deeper understanding of India’s federal framework and its continuing journey.

title: Master Guide to NTA UGC NET | SET | JRF | PhD Paper 1 (Teaching and Research Aptitude),7/e
author: Harpreet Kaur
subject: Academic
description:
•	Comprehensive coverage of all the topics as per the new syllabus and the latest exam trends
•	All concepts explained in a simple and lucid language for easy understanding
•	Numerous tips as well as tricks to help solve tough questions in the shortest possible time 
•	4000+ Practice Questions at the end of each chapter along with coverage of Previous Years’ Question Papers (2004 – 2025)
•	Real-time practice through eleven free Mock Tests, which can be accessed on the portal Egzaminer using the scratch code provided in the inside cover
•	Strategy to crack NET exam in the first attempt 
•	Detailed step by step explanation for reasoning and data interpretation questions 
•	List of days of national and international importance

title: Sashakt Nari Viksit Bharat – Women-Led Development @ 2047
author: Shishir Priyadarshi & Dr Cchavi Vasisht
subject: BGR
description:
Sashakt Nari, Viksit Bharat: Women-Led Development @ 2047 offers a comprehensive and forward-looking exploration of how gender will shape India’s journey toward becoming a developed nation by the centenary of Independence. Organised thematically, the volume combines research-based scholarship with grounded analysis to examine the economic, political, social, and legal foundations of women-led development.
The book begins by analysing women’s role in the economy—valuing unpaid care work, addressing the paradox of educated yet underrepresented women in the workforce, tracing entrepreneurship pathways, examining inequities in global trade, and discussing land and asset ownership. It then moves to political and institutional participation, exploring the shift from representation to leadership across governance, law, defence services, diplomacy, and peacekeeping.
The discussion further engages with social and cultural factors shaping opportunity, including health and safety, climate-responsive policy, disaster management, and media narratives. It also evaluates constitutional principles, legislative frameworks, public health governance, gender-sensitive local models, transgender healthcare regulation, and mechanisms to address violence against women.
Drawing these themes together, the concluding reflections place women-led development within India’s long-term national vision, identifying pathways for inclusive growth and institutional reform—making this an essential reference for policymakers, scholars, practitioners, and informed citizens alike.

title: Stakeholder Management : A Board and C-Suite Level Guide to Engagement, Governance and Sustainable Value Creation
author: Rupam Tandon
subject: BGR
description:
In an era where financial returns are no longer the sole metric of success, stakeholder management has evolved from a “soft skill” into a strategic muscle and a leadership imperative.
Stakeholder Management : A Board and C-Suite Level Guide to Engagement, Governance and Sustainable Value Creation serves as a practical roadmap for C-suite executives, board members, and professionals to navigate this complex landscape. Moving beyond simple compliance checklists, this book is developed to be a deeply insightful guide to elevating stakeholder voices within corporate decision-making.
This actionable toolkit equips leaders with:
• Proven Frameworks: Master strategic navigation using models to prioritize engagement eﬀectively.
Real-World Intelligence: Gain ringside insights through case studies of industry leaders.
• Conflict Resolution: Learn to transform friction into “forward motion” using structured escalation ladders.
• Future-Proofing: Prepare for emerging trends such as AI-driven engagement, Web3, and Stakeholder Impact Tokens (SITs).
Whether you are integrating stakeholder insights into ESG reporting or managing high-stakes reputational risks, this guide ensures that trust remains your North Star.

title: A Treatise and Commentary on Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
author: Dr K K Khandelwal & Apoorva Kumar Singh
subject: Law
description:
A Treatise and Commentary on Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 is a definitive guide to India’s transformative privacy law, balancing individual rights with technological and economic progress.
The authors meticulously dissect each section, providing detailed commentary and critical appraisal of the legal framework and operational mechanics. The treatise offers comprehensive analysis of legislative milestones and data privacy evolution, weaving in comparative insights from international regimes like GDPR. It presents balanced critique, examining the Act’s strengths while highlighting challenges in cross-border transfers and government exemptions, alongside practical compliance guidelines.
Essential for data protection officers, legal practitioners, adjudication officers, policymakers, academics, and data fiduciaries, this book equips readers with necessary knowledge and tools for implementing the DPDP Act effectively.

title: Insights into the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
author: Dr Prabhat Kumar & Dr K K Khandelwal
subject: Law
description:
The Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (POCSO) stands as a landmark legislative affirmation of this duty, recognizing children as rights-holders entitled to safety, dignity, and a fear-free childhood. In Insights into the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, the authors provide a structured and systematic guide designed to bridge the gap between bare legal provisions and the everyday realities of the criminal justice system.
This comprehensive volume offers:
• A section-wise, reader-friendly presentation of the POCSO framework.
• Practical guidance for stakeholders, including police officers, medical professionals, prosecutors, and judges, to ensure child-friendly procedures.
• An emphasis on minimizing trauma and preventing re-victimization through sensitive investigation and trial management.
• Insights into the constitutional context and judicial interpretations that shape the application of the Act.
Whether you are a legal practitioner, a student of law, or a professional entrusted with
